quotes.text: When he moved into the English-language market, Enrique pushed the Latin thing as hard and as shamelessly as he possibly could. The end result is a song that embraces the whole Latin-lover stereotype as hard as Rudolph Valentino in a Zorro mask with a rose clamped between his teeth -- a song so over-the-top in its sexy theatricality that I can't help but admire it.
He recorded in Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, German, even Russian.
The romance and passion that Iglesias brings with his music is unparalleled.
With such a strong and identifiable voice, Iglesias has been releasing albums since 1969 on a regular basis and scores well with this new effort.
